import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static long roundToNearest(long num, long den) {
        long q = num / den;
        long r = num % den;
        if (r > den - r) q += 1;
        return q;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        long bestNum = 0, bestDen = 1;
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long temp = roundToNearest(x * i, y);
            long left = bestDen * (x * i - temp * y);
            long right = i * (x * bestDen - y * bestNum);
            if (Math.abs(left) < Math.abs(right)) {
                bestNum = temp;
                bestDen = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
